author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: the climbing plane now has a short, nearly horizontal tail top with a smoothly curved underside, and a narrower lower wing (8 across) with a slanted tip whose leading edge curves into the belly; the ground line is unchanged. Earlier attempts in attempts/ (the trailing edge merged into the belly; a tall fin) read as a boot or a bird.
omissions: The trailing edge keeps a small notch where it meets the belly so the wing stays distinct.
